newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission seeks action on corruption.
newsitem.headline: Commission seeks action on corruption.

text.p: The European Union should agree to criminalise bribery of foreign officials by EU enterprises and corruption in the private sector, the European Commission said on Wednesday.

The ideas are contained in a communication on fighting corruption drawn up by Justice Commissioner Anita Gradin which also proposes getting rid at EU level of tax deductibility for bribes, which is already banned in the United States and Japan.

It also wants in cooperation with the OECD and the World Trade Organisation to draw up tighter rules worldwide for public procurement and at an EU level to set blacklists of companies and people found to be involved in corruption.
The Commission said in a statement that its communication only covered areas where policies at national level required additional EU action.
